scenarios.description: Context.md demo test case: identity + case hint in one utterance, then grounded follow-up and email.

transcript.content: Hi, thanks for calling claims support. I'm Avery. Before I can look into any claim, I need to verify your identity. Please share any 3 of: your full name, date of birth, phone number, email address, or the last 4 digits of your SSN or national ID. How can I help today?
I'm the policyholder. My name is Margaret Chen, policy POL-9921. I'm calling about my denied healthcare claim from January. DOB is 1985-03-15, SSN last four is 4472.

Thanks, Margaret. You’re verified, and I’ve pulled up your healthcare claim CL-2048. It was denied because the review file didn’t include the pathology report and the treating provider office note, and the documents needed are those two items. Your appeal deadline has passed, so options after a passed appeal deadline are reviewed by a human representative, and you can ask to be connected; would you like me to transfer you to one now?
Why was it denied and what do I need to send?

Your healthcare claim CL-2048 was denied because the review file didn’t include the pathology report and the treating provider office note. To address that, you’ll need to send a pathology report and the treating provider office note. Since the appeal deadline status is passed, options after a passed appeal deadline are reviewed by a human representative, and you can ask to be connected—would you like me to transfer you to a human representative?
Got it, Margaret. I can email you a summary of your call, including the denial reason and the next steps for claim CL-2048, to m***@email.com—would you like me to send it or skip sending it?
Thanks. I’ve sent the summary to m***@email.com. Take care, and thanks for calling claims support.
